name: Selvala
description: A well-respected elven explorer whom Adriana asks to be senator of a new Republic of Paliano.

timeline.summary: At a private dinner, Selvala tells the withered King Brago that he is no longer the king she remembers and that she begged him to refuse the Custodi's treatments.
timeline.quote: I begged you not to let the Custodi begin their treatments.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Brago and Selvala work inseparably, build a coalition, and together draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
Flashback: three years into his reign, Brago is diagnosed with an incurable hereditary illness, and he and Selvala reluctantly agree to the priests' magical preservation treatments.
timeline.quote: The Custodi were formed, and the king lived.

timeline.summary: Selvala accuses Brago of valuing his own life above those he served and says she would call any other man who spoke so a tyrant.
timeline.quote: if I heard those words from any other man's lips, I would know him to be a tyrant.

timeline.summary: Brago reveals there will be no more treatments because they have gone too far, and begs Selvala to kill him.
timeline.quote: I cannot die naturally. But I think I must die.

timeline.summary: Selvala forgives Brago and stabs him through the heart; his body crumbles to dust as he whispers that she will not, and she is escorted from the room.
timeline.quote: His ancient body began to crumble almost immediately

timeline.summary: Months later Adriana visits the elven explorer Selvala at her home.
timeline.quote: The elven explorer Selvala stood on the other side of the door

timeline.summary: Adriana proposes that Selvala serve as senator to halt Paliano's murderous monarchy.
timeline.quote: the finest nominee for a senator I can think of.

timeline.summary: Adriana asks Selvala to help build the Republic of Paliano.
timeline.quote: Will you help us build the Republic of Paliano?

timeline.summary: Leovold recounts that Selvala once drafted the Charter with Brago and was repaid with betrayal and imprisonment (backstory).
timeline.quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

timeline.summary: Leovold meets Selvala at a cafe, suggests a capable caretaker should rule, and promises her Trestian cousins' support.
timeline.quote: her cousins back in Trest would be extremely interested in supporting her in any of her future endeavors

timeline.summary: Leovold notes that Selvala and others look to exploit the unrest against the nobility.
timeline.quote: Some, including the illustrious and storied Selvala, are looking to take advantage of the unrest

timeline.summary: The explorer Selvala was one of the first to travel the frontier, seeking the world beyond the nobles' debauchery.
timeline.quote: The explorer Selvala was one of the first to travel the frontier

pages_say.description: An elf explorer and Brago's friend who helped found Paliano and, at his request, kills him.
A well-respected elven explorer whom Adriana asks to be senator of a new Republic of Paliano.
An earnest, hat-loving elven woman who drafted the Charter with Brago, was betrayed and imprisoned, and now considers striking back against the nobility.
An explorer, one of the first to travel Fiora's frontier.
